**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared regulatory mechanisms involving CDKN1C and KCNQ1OT1 could reveal novel therapeutic targets for conditions characterized by both overgrowth and platelet abnormalities, potentially leading to more targeted treatments for developmental disorders.
